pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 40 °C·d above 15.5 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1150 °C·d$(). Best near 30 °C; stops above 40 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -0.5 °C (0 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 5.8-8 (tolerates 5-8.5). Roots 1.3 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 130, P 22, K 120 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 2 bales/ac (2.5 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Cotton Boll and Cotton Seeds.
